messages:
Nina: Pushed a one-pager called 'Compliance Compass'  single-slide brief for security, SLA bullets, deploy mode tradeoffs, and a tiny benchmark. Need microcopy + inbound routing rules. Doc: https://docs.google.com/d/compliance-compass
Omar: Nice structure. Quick asks: 1) add a 2-line benchmark card (p95 + unit cost delta hosted vs dedicated), 2) two microcopy CTAs (gated + high-touch).
Dee: For webinar tie-in, propose we A/B subject lines and use the brief as the post-webinar download. Subjects:
```
A: Compliance Compass: secure LLM serving for regulated teams
B: How to meet SLAs & compliance while running LLMs in production
```
Rohit: Draft benchmark: "p95 ~145ms for standard gen flows; hosted est ~$0.019 / 1k tokens. Dedicated reserved capacity can reduce unit cost ~35% at steady utilization." Keep it sales-friendly.
Nina: Good. For CTA microcopy, two options: (1) gated: 'Download Compliance Compass: SLAs & deployment checklist' (2) high-touch: 'Request a secure deployment scoping call'. Which should be primary?
Omar: Primary gated works for top-of-funnel. High-touch as a contextual link for flagged leads. Also suggest a short form microcopy: 'Get the 1-page Compliance Compass'.
Dee: Inbound routing pseudo-rules (simple YAML style) - auto-attach + priority flags:
```
routes:
  - if: form.fields.includes('requires_SLA') OR lead.tags.includes('regulated')
    attach: Compliance-Compass.pdf
    assign: enterprise-field
    priority: P1
  - if: form.request.includes('on-prem') OR form.request.includes('air-gapped')
    assign: solutions-engineering
    notify: security@redwood.com
  - else:
    assign: growth-sdr
```
Dee: Also add an SDR note template: 'Lead requires SLA/compliance discussion; attach Compliance Compass; recommend 30m scoping call.'
Rohit: Webinar 30s talking point: 'Teams balancing latency, cost, and compliance choose deployment modes. Redwood's runtime gives you predictable p95s, network isolation (VPC/on-prem), and automated fallbacks so your product stays live during model upgrades or regional failures.'
Nina: Social post drafts (short):
- "New: Compliance Compass  1 page on SLAs, secure deploy modes, and quick benchmarks. Download -> [link]"
- "Serving LLMs under SLAs? Our one-page Compliance Compass explains options + costs. Grab it here -> [link]"
Omar: Recommend we design a stat-card image: single stat + 1-line benefit. I'll file a quick ticket with design (specs: 1200x600, alt text: 'p95 latency & cost snapshot').
Dee: For webinar follow-up email, include the PDF + stat-card image + CTA to request scoping call for those who picked 'enterprise' on the form. Also segment opens by industry for tailored SE outreach.
Nina: Action items: Rohit -> drop benchmark & 30s line into the doc (done). Omar -> design ticket + A/B subject test setup. Dee -> push inbound rules into playbook and add SDR template. Nina -> finalize microcopy and schedule social + webinar announcement. Target: finalize by Tue EOD. :rocket:
DeployBot: Calendar event created: 'Compliance Compass final review' Tue 10:00 AM. Invited: Nina, Omar, Dee, Rohit.
